name: Rangitoto Summit Track
why: A ferry ride from downtown Auckland, then black lava fields and pōhutukawa forest up to the crater rim of the city's youngest volcano.
book: Free, no booking. Ferry from Queens Wharf (25 min) or Devonport (20 min): book it and keep the return time. The island is pest free: check and clean your gear.
water: No water or food on the island: carry 1-2 litres per person.
dangers: Black lava reflects heat: very hot in summer, little shade.
Rough, loose volcanic rock: wear shoes with grip.
Lava caves are dark and low: bring a torch.
turnaround: Be back at the wharf 15 min before your return ferry; the last one does not wait.

points.name: Rangitoto Wharf
points.note: Ferry wharf and the carved gateway; the Summit Track starts past the historic Scouts bach.

points.name: Rangitoto lava fields
points.note: Black scoria with pōhutukawa growing out of it; turn-offs to Wilson's Park and the lava caves follow.

points.name: Rangitoto summit crater
points.note: Summit Lookout at 259 m over the 60 m deep crater, Auckland and the Hauraki Gulf. The crater rim loop is 20 min.
